correctness.rationale: The exact residual recursion a_(2n+rho)=a_n+E[a_B]+rho for B~Bin(n,1/2) and base a_0=0,a_1=1 follows from pairwise XOR and conditionally unbiased equal-pair bits. The pointwise quadratic support z^alpha >= 1+alpha(z-1)-(z-1)^2 for z>=0 yields binomial concavity deficit <= (1/2)(n/2)^(alpha-1) <= 1-2^-n (n>=2); n=1 is direct. The strong induction with atom B=0 then proves the tighter lower envelope, Jensen proves the upper envelope including the odd case. Own independent rational recurrence reproduced a_1..a_8 and 1..300 finite inequalities; these are corroboration, not the infinite induction.
residual_risks: Resultary November 2 theorem ALREADY proves the same Theta(N^alpha) order and a two-sided all-length inequality with weaker coefficients; exponent and nonasymptotic Theta are not new. Novelty here is restricted to explicit sharper constants (1/2 versus 1/10, 2 versus 3) and a tighter concavity-deficit lemma.

The submitted Relationship to prior work omits this stronger pre-existing Resultary theorem, so any future publication must correct the priority description and avoid claiming that Theta(N^alpha) first appears here.
The numerical constants are not known to be optimal; no normalized-limit convergence or worst-case residual-weight bound follows.
